# U163: A baseline and nothing else yet (GB): as Tunde, New goal’s measure step with a Baseline of 0.42 USD and no Target offers “No target agreed yet? Propose it with just the baseline”; Check reads “A number at 0.42 USD now. No target is set yet”, and Propose goal saves it with no target; its page says “Target not set” with Set the target as its one primary and no status shape; Set the target opens Change it, and once 0.30 is saved it can be made active

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `GOAL-NO-TARGET`, `GOAL-PROPOSED`
- **Budget:** at most 22 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Tunde, at `/goals/new` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 6748

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Tunde (`tunde`).
- Go to `/goals/new` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/what”.
- **Step.** Type “Cost per pipeline run” into the “Name it the way” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/who”.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/measure”.
- **Step.** Type “USD” into the “Unit” field.
- **Step.** Type “0.42” into the “Baseline” field.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “No target agreed yet? Propose it with just the baseline” button is visible (else: the measure step with a Baseline and no Target doesn’t offer to propose it without one).
- **Step.** Press the “No target agreed yet? Propose it with just the baseline” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/new/check”.
- **Check:** “A number at 0.42 USD now. No target is set yet” is shown (else: Check doesn’t read back that no target is set).
- **Check:** (`errors`) the “Not yet: propose it” choice is ticked (else: “Is it under way?” isn’t on “Not yet: propose it” after choosing to propose it).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “check”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Propose goal” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/…?…published=1”.
- **Check:** The goal proposed (`.goal-proposed`) shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** “Target not set” is shown in the goal proposed (`.goal-proposed`) (else: the proposed goal’s page doesn’t say “Target not set”).
- **Check:** (`a11y`) a status shape in the goal proposed (`.goal-proposed`) is not there (else: a goal with no target draws a status shape).
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if the goal wasn’t saved proposed, as a number goal with its baseline and no target.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if the one primary reads “{worked out in the journey as `(await primary.first().innerText().catch(() => '')).trim()`}”, not “Set the target”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “target not set”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the main button in the proposed actions (`.proposed-actions .btn.primary`) in the goal proposed (`.goal-proposed`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “/edit”.
- **Check:** The part `[data-field="target"]` shows.
- **Step.** Type “0.30” into the part `[data-field="target"]`.
- **Step.** Press the “Save changes” button.
- **Check:** The address changes.
- **Check:** The goal proposed (`.goal-proposed`) shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if once its target is set, the page doesn’t offer Make it active.
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if the target wasn’t saved.
- Close this browser.
